campaign.name: Perfumarte AI Art Direction
campaign.objective: Generate two visually coherent premium campaign images for Agua de Vetiver (YLY), translating its fresh, aromatic, smoky and sophisticated identity into an editorial still life and an immersive surreal companion image.

visual_relationship.rule: Both images must represent the same fragrance concept and olfactive identity.

physical_scale_system.scale_reference: Use the perfume bottle as the physical scale reference for the entire scene.
physical_scale_system.element_scale_rule: Every surrounding ingredient and environmental object must have realistic physical proportions relative to the perfume bottle.
physical_scale_system.relative_scale: Every surrounding ingredient and environmental object must have realistic physical proportions relative to the perfume bottle.
physical_scale_system.artistic_scale_override: Do not create abundance by artificially enlarging ingredients.

fragrance_data.name: Agua de Vetiver (YLY)
fragrance_data.description:
Agua de Vetiver (YLY): un perfume fresco masculino, elegante y con carácter

Agua de Vetiver (YLY) es un perfume fresco masculino creado para hombres soñadores, creativos y decididos. Una fragancia que combina frescura inicial con una base profunda y sensual, reflejando la dualidad del hombre moderno: ligero por fuera, intenso por dentro.

Este perfume fresco masculino destaca por su elegancia natural y su evolución olfativa equilibrada, ideal para quienes buscan una fragancia con personalidad propia.

 

 

¿A qué huele Agua de Vetiver (YLY)?

Agua de Vetiver (YLY) es un perfume fresco masculino donde el geranio, el incienso y el vetiver crean una fragancia limpia, aromática y con un fondo cálido y sofisticado.

Una salida ligera y fresca

La fragancia se abre con una sensación fresca y luminosa que transmite energía, libertad y optimismo desde el primer instante.

Un corazón aromático y elegante

El absoluto de geranio aporta un carácter floral-verde refinado, masculino y moderno que da estructura a la fragancia.

Un fondo intenso, sensual y profundo

El incienso y el vetiver construyen una base poderosa, ligeramente ahumada y muy elegante que deja una estela duradera y sofisticada.

olfactive_translation.principle: Translate the fragrance into a visual story rather than literally representing every listed note.
selection_rules: Select only the most visually expressive olfactive elements.
Prioritize elements that communicate the fragrance identity.
Do not visually represent every note by default.
Atmospheric notes may be represented through color, texture, material, smoke, light or environment.
Never introduce ingredients that are not supported by the fragrance data.
The selected visual elements must work coherently across both campaign images.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Base note; earthy, dry, green and sophisticated foundation.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Natural vetiver roots and slender dried green blades, arranged in compact realistic bundles with a few exposed fibrous roots.
selected_visual_notes.reason: The defining signature of the fragrance and its strongest visual link to the name.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Main botanical grouping beside and behind the bottle, with roots and blades creating tactile foreground and midground layers.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: Root fragments and fine grass blades suspended within a controlled current of mist and smoky air, suggesting an underground-to-atmospheric transition.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Base note; smoky, resinous, warm and spiritual depth.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Small amber resin tears, a few natural frankincense pieces and a thin translucent ribbon of pale smoke.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Communicates the fragrance's warm, slightly smoky and elegant drydown.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Subtle resin cluster on the surface with smoke rising behind the bottle without crossing the label or cap.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A physically coherent plume of incense smoke swirls through the environment, carrying a few tiny resin particles while preserving clear separation from the bottle.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Heart note; floral-green, refined and aromatic structure.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Several realistic geranium stems with green leaves and restrained pink-red blossoms, kept botanically proportionate.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Explicitly identified as the elegant floral-green heart of the perfume.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Secondary grouped botanical mass in the midground, framing one side of the bottle without covering it and adding refined color accents.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: Geranium stems and leaves emerge naturally from a distant atmospheric plane, with a few detached petals moving gently through the air.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Top note; luminous, fresh and citrus-bright opening.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Several small bergamot fruits, one naturally cut to reveal pale segmented pulp, with restrained zest texture.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Adds the immediate fresh, luminous and energetic opening without introducing excessive fruit imagery.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Moderate foreground cluster placed low and lateral to the bottle, including whole and cut fruit for material variation.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A few realistically sized bergamot halves and peel fragments drift near a cool mist current, with droplets and translucent citrus light suggesting freshness.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Top note; crisp, spicy and energetic freshness.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Several irregular fresh ginger rhizomes, thin slices and a small scattering of moist cut pieces.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Provides tactile contrast and a sharp natural energy that complements the citrus opening.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Supporting foreground and midground detail, grouped near the bergamot and partially overlapping the vetiver roots.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: Small ginger fragments remain suspended in a controlled flow near the lower composition, with no artificial geometric arrangement.

shared_visual_identity.concept: La dualidad de la tierra húmeda y el aire luminoso: una corriente fresca de bergamota y jengibre atraviesa un paisaje táctil de vetiver, geranio e incienso ahumado.
shared_visual_identity.emotional_goal: Transmitir la dualidad de un hombre moderno: ligero, creativo y luminoso en la superficie, pero intenso, decidido y profundamente sofisticado en su interior.
shared_visual_identity.environmental_identity: Un entorno mineral y botánico de piedra húmeda, vegetación aromática, aire fresco y humo fino, construido como una transición entre un estudio editorial naturalista y un espacio atmosférico suspendido.
visual_anchor_elements: botella negra con diseño exacto de referencia

editorial_still_life.concept: El refugio mineral del vetiver: la botella vertical y estable sobre una losa de piedra oscura húmeda, rodeada por una abundancia controlada de raíces, cítricos, geranio, jengibre y resina ahumada.

environment.description: Una superficie horizontal de piedra volcánica gris carbón, ligeramente húmeda y con reflejos controlados. El fondo sugiere una pared mineral oscura con una transición suave hacia verde grisáceo, sin convertirse en un paisaje literal. La botella se apoya en el plano medio, completamente vertical, estable y plenamente visible.
environment.background_rule: The environment may be a studio wall, architectural setting, elegant interior, natural landscape, stone setting or other appropriate environment depending on the fragrance.

visual_elements: botella de Agua de Vetiver (YLY) completamente visible y vertical

composition.negative_space: Generous negative space in the upper-left and far-right background for Spanish typography, while ingredient richness remains concentrated around the lower and lateral still-life zone.
composition.depth: Clear foreground, midground and background: blurred bergamot peel and ginger detail in foreground; bottle and principal ingredient group in midground; geranium, vetiver silhouettes, smoke and mineral wall in background.
composition.bottle_priority: The bottle is the highest visual priority, centered slightly off-axis, sharply focused, fully unobstructed and visually separated from every ingredient.

lighting.direction: Soft directional light from upper left with a controlled cool fill from the right and a restrained warm rim on the incense resin.
lighting.contrast: Medium-high contrast with protected label detail, deep but readable shadows and precise glass highlights.

rules: Typography must never cover the perfume bottle.
Text must integrate naturally with the composition.
Do not overload the image with text.

immersive_surreal.concept: Una corriente invisible de aire fresco atraviesa un estrato de tierra, raíces y humo: la botella suspendida cerca del centro se convierte en el núcleo estable de una atmósfera olfativa en movimiento.

environment.description: Un espacio tridimensional construido con una base de piedra húmeda desenfocada en primer plano, una corriente de niebla fría y vetiver alrededor del plano medio, y un fondo profundo de verdes oscuros, humo de incienso y destellos de luz cítrica. La botella flota cerca del centro y del eje principal, completamente separada y visible, con una inclinación fija de aproximadamente 8 grados: el tapón ligeramente desplazado hacia la izquierda y la base hacia la derecha.

visual_elements: botella suspendida y dominante con inclinación lateral fija de 8 grados hacia la izquierda en la parte superior
raíces de vetiver y hojas en diferentes distancias de cámara
humo fino y físicamente coherente de incienso
resina de incienso suspendida cerca de la corriente de humo
bergamota cortada y fragmentos de piel cítrica
pequeños fragmentos de jengibre y rodajas finas
ramas y hojas de geranio integradas en un plano posterior
piedra húmeda y gotas desenfocadas en primer plano
niebla mineral azul verdosa atravesada por luz cálida

composition.depth: Strong foreground, midground and background separation: large partially cropped blurred vetiver roots, stone and droplets close to camera; the bottle and main botanical current in the midground; smoke, geranium and mineral atmosphere receding into the background.
composition.bottle_priority: The bottle remains the dominant focal point, sharply focused, fully visible, recognizable and clearly separated from all surrounding elements.
composition.negative_space: Controlled atmospheric separation around the bottle, with denser material activity toward the lower foreground and lateral background rather than empty uniform space.

lighting.direction: Cool directional backlight from upper right combined with a soft warm side light from lower left, creating controlled rim highlights on glass, citrus and resin.
lighting.contrast: Dramatic medium-high contrast with luminous atmospheric separation and preserved detail in the bottle label and cap.
